mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.25% compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy remains accommodative.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.25%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.5 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering equity sell-offs due to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings growth expectations over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.5pp, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate broad-based consumer demand weakness, reducing corporate revenue growth expectations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both RSAFS and HOUST decline, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 100 (INDPRO < 100) during manufacturing sector weakness reduces corporate profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals rising inflation expectations, prompting Federal Reserve policy tightening and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL rises > 0.3pp, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained unemployment above 9.5% (UNRATE > 9.5%) suppresses consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 9.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In post-recession recovery phases, a monthly retail sales increase exceeding 0.5% signals strengthening consumer demand, supporting corporate revenue growth and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when RSAFS rises > 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and unemployment rate increases (UNRATE) indicate dual supply-labor market shocks, reducing corporate profitability and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO declines and UNRATE rises, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.
